Title: BUGÜNE KADAR SOMALİ’YE YAPILAN YARDIMLAR 1 MİLYAR DOLARI GEÇMİŞTİR
Paragraphs:
Ankara'da Somali Milli Günü'nde konuşan Bakan Pakdemirli, "Türkiye, Somali'ye desteğini kapsayıcı bir vizyonla devam ettiriyor. Somali'nin ekonomik olarak kalkındırılması ve devlet kurumlarının yeniden inşasına yönelik yardımlarımızı sürdürüyoruz. Bugüne kadar Somali'ye yapılan insani ve kalkınma yardımlarımızın miktarı 1 milyar ABD dolarını aşmıştır." dedi.
Tarım ve Orman Bakanı Dr. Bekir Pakdemirli, başkentte bir otelde "1 Temmuz Somali Milli Günü" dolayısıyla verilen resepsiyona iştirak etti.
İki ülke milli marşlarının okunmasıyla başlayan programda konuşan Bakan Pakdemirli, Somali'nin bağımsızlığının yıl dönümünü Türk hükümeti adına kutlayarak, Türkiye-Somali ilişkilerinin tarihi bağlara ve ortak değerlere dayandığını belirtti.
Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın 2011'de bu ülkeye ziyaretinin ilişkilerin dönüm noktasını teşkil ettiğini kaydeden Pakdemirli, bu ziyaretin dostluğu, kardeşliği ve dayanışmayı güçlendirdiğini söyledi.
Bütün olumsuzluklara rağmen son birkaç yılda Somali'nin gözle görülür şekilde ilerleme kat ettiğinin altını çizen Pakdemirli, on yıllar süren şiddet ve felaketlerin ardından artık başkent Mogadişu'da ticaretin atak yaptığını ve dünya etrafında yaşayan Somalililerin yeniden ülkelerine döndüğünü aktardı.
Somali'de istikrar ve güvenliğin sağlanması için temel mücadelenin sürdürüldüğünü anımsatan Pakdemirli, Somali barışı için uluslararası toplumun desteğinin sürekliliğine olan ihtiyacı vurguladı.
İki ülke arasındaki çok yönlü iş birliğine değindiği konuşmasında Bakan Pakdemirli şunları dile getirdi:
"Türkiye, Somali'ye desteğini kapsayıcı bir vizyonla devam ettiriyor. Somali'nin ekonomik olarak kalkındırılması ve devlet kurumlarının yeniden inşasına yönelik yardımlarımızı sürdürüyoruz. Ülkenin farklı bölgelerinde eğitim, sağlık, belediye, altyapı ve su kuyuları gibi çeşitli alanlarda çok sayıda kalkınma projesi ya bitirildi ya da yolda. Türk özel sektörünü, bütçe desteğimizle, Somali'ye yatırım yapmaları için teşvik ediyoruz. Somali'deki Türk üssü TURKSOM'un konsolide, disiplinli ve fedakar bir Somali Ulusal Ordusunun kurulması amacıyla askeri desteğini devam ettiriyor. Söz konusu eğitim merkezimizde Somali polis özel harekât personelini de eğitiyoruz.
Türkiye sivil toplum örgütleri ile de sahada faaliyet yürütmekte ve insani ve kalkınma yardımları temelinde çok çeşitli projeler gerçekleştirmektedir. Bugüne kadar Somali'ye yapılan insani ve kalkınma yardımlarımızın miktarı 1 milyar ABD dolarını aşmıştır. Türkiye'de yaşayan ve eğitim gören Somalililerin artan sayısı, dostluk ve dayanışma bağlarımızın açık bir göstergesidir. Somali-Somaliland arasındaki görüşmelerde de arabuluculuk ve kolaylaştırıcılık girişimlerimizi sürdürüyoruz. Afrika ve özellikle Somali ile ilişkilerimizin ve iş birliğimizin, 'Afrika Ortaklık Politikamızın' önümüzdeki yıllarda da önemli bir parçası olmaya devam edeceğinin altını çizmek isterim."

Title: ÜLKEMİZDE YETERLİ KURBANLIK HAYVAN BULUNUYOR
Paragraphs:
Yaklaşan Kurban Bayramı öncesi çalışmalar hızlandırıldı. Bu yıl da kurbanlık hayvan sayısında herhangi bir sıkıntı yaşanmayacak.
Tarım ve Orman Bakanı Dr. Bekir Pakdemirli yaklaşan Kurban Bayramı dolayısıyla açıklamada bulunarak, mevcut hayvan varlığımızın kurbanlık ihtiyacını karşılayacak seviyede olduğunu belirtti.
Pakdemirli, "Kurbanlık olarak ülkemizde bu yıl 1 milyon 217 bin büyükbaş,  3 milyon 895 bin adet ise küçükbaş hayvanımız var" dedi. Geçtiğimiz yıl Kurban Bayramı'nda kesilen hayvan sayılarını da hatırlatan Pakdemirli, "2018 yılında büyükbaş 866 bin, küçükbaş 2 milyon 682 bin olarak gerçekleşti. Netice itibarıyla bu yıl sahip olduğumuz kurbanlık hayvan varlığı, bayramda herhangi bir sıkıntının yaşanmayacağını gösteriyor" ifadelerini kullandı.
VETERİNER SAĞLIK RAPORU OLAN HAYVANLARIN İLLER ARASI NAKLİNE İZİN VERİLECEK
"Salgın veya bulaşıcı hayvan hastalığı bulunan, kayıt altına alınmamış, kulak küpesiz ve yanlarında sığır cinsi hayvanlar için pasaport, koyun keçi türü hayvanlar için nakil belgesi bulunmayan hayvanların sevklerine, alınıp satılmalarına ve kesilmelerine hiçbir surette izin verilmeyecektir diyen Pakdemirli şöyle devam etti:
"Kurbanlık olarak sevk edilecek hayvanların resmi veteriner hekimler tarafından muayene ve gerekli kontrolleri yapılacak, sağlıklı bulunan hayvanlar için veteriner sağlık raporu düzenlenerek iller arası nakline müsaade edilecek"
ARINDIRILMIŞ BÖLGE TRAKYA'YA KURBANLIKLARIN SEVKİNDE GEREKLİ TÜM KONTROLLER YAPILACAK
Bakan Pakdemirli ayrıca, Kurbanlıkların arındırılmış bölge Trakya'ya sevki sırasında gerekli tüm kontrollerin yapılacağını da ifade etti.
Anadolu'da bulunan illerden hastalıklara karşı arındırılmış bölge olarak ilan edilen Trakya'ya sevk edilecek hayvanlar için de veteriner sağlık raporu düzenlenmesi gerektiğinin altını çizen Pakdemirli, bunun yanında bazı şartlarında yerine getirilmesi gerektiğini söyledi.
Trakya'ya sevk edilecek hayvanların doğumlarından itibaren işletme değiştirmemiş veya en az 3 aydır halen bulundukları işletmede barındırılmış olması gerektiğini söyleyen Pakdemirli şöyle devam etti: "Hayvanlar sevk öncesinde 30 gün süre ile bir işletmede izole edilmeli, bu süre sonunda Şap Enstitüsü Müdürlüğünce yapılan NSP test sonuçları negatif olmalıdır."
Tarım ve Orman Bakanı Pakdemirli, bu şartlar yerine getirilmeden Anadolu'dan Trakya'ya sevk edilen hayvanlar için de gerekli idari yaptırımların uygulanacağını vurguladı.
KURBANLIK FİYATLARI TAKİP EDİLECEK
Kurbanlık hayvanların sağlık şartları ve sevkleriyle ilgili kontrollerin eksiksiz yerine getirileceğini vurgulayan Bakan Pakdemirli, kurbanlık hayvan fiyatlarının Bayramın ikinci günü dâhil son 20 gün boyunca takip edileceğini de sözlerine ekledi.

Title: “FOOD INSPECTION BEFORE RAMAZAN FEAST IN ANKARA”
Paragraphs:
The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry continues its inspections before the Ramadan Feast as during the year to ensure healthy and quality food for our citizens.
Within this scope, the teams of the Provincial Directorate of Ankara Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry carried out inspection to sweets and candy manufacturing establishments before the Ramadan Feast. During the inspections, the hygiene conditions of the workplaces and the quality of the materials used were examined and samples were taken.
The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry frequently carried out food inspections before Ramadan. Ankara Provincial Directorate, carried out a large-scale inspection to sweets and candy manufacturing establishments just before the Ramadan. The products were inspected in a wide range from storage conditions to the temperature of the cabinets, hygiene, production company, barcode and expiry date.
"32 THOUSANDS OF COMPANIES WERE CONTROLLED IN 5 MONTHS"
Ankara Agriculture and Forest Manager Bülent Korkmaz, in his statement during the investigations, said that they continued food inspections in the city throughout the year, 32 thousand businesses were controlled as of the end of May and this number will find 70 thousand by the end of the year.
Korkmaz pointed out that the demand for product groups such as Turkish delight, confectionery and baklava increased due to the upcoming holiday and said that during this period, in line with the instructions given by the Ministry, intensive audits were conducted in 81 provinces.
Korkmaz said that, the sugar content of Turkish delight, dyes or additives or desserts used in raw materials such as peanuts and walnuts to determine whether the samples will be analyzed in the laboratory
Korkmaz stated that the samples taken will be analyzed in the laboratory in order to determine whether the sugar content in Turkish delight, dyes or additives or the raw materials such as peanuts and walnuts used in desserts are imitated and according to the results necessary assessments will be made about the businesses.
"AUDITING TO 6 THOUSAND 500 BUSINESSES IN RAMADAN"
Korkmaz stated that they controlled total of 6 thousand 500 businesses during the month of Ramadan and reported that they detected negativity in 500 businesses.
Korkmaz stated that the companies are given time to eliminate these problems, and said that "Some of these businesses made the necessary corrections. In spite of all warnings, administrative fines were also imposed on more than 80 jobs that did not make corrections, did not comply with food legislation, and did not comply with hygiene conditions."
"WE ARE THE SIDE OF THE INVISIBLE FACE OF FOOD"
Korkmaz said that they are on the manufacturing side, which is the invisible face of food, and explained that they carried out inspections in Ankara with more than 250 food inspection personnel at individual manufacturing points.
Korkmaz stated that, opportunists appeared on the market before the feast, so it is important to receive products from enterprises with business registration certificate.
Korkmaz pointed out that consumers may call the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry 174 "Alo Food Line" in case of any suspicious situation in the products and the relevant provincial or district directorate will apply the necessary sanctions as a result of applications.

Title: SPECIAL INVITATION FOR PRESIDENT ERDOĞAN VIA MINISTER PAKDEMİRLİ
Paragraphs:
A special invitation message was sent to President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan from the house in Istanbul-Beykoz where Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Bekir Pakdemirli was hosted at sahur.
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Bekir Pakdemirli participated in the sahur in the house of the mukhtar of the Istanbul-Beykoz Göksu District, Gül Bağdatlı.
Issues related to the district and the upcoming Istanbul elections were discussed during Sahur due to the fact that the householder was the mukhtar.
After Sahur, Nazmiye Bağdatlı who is one of the relatives of Gül Bağdatlı, and the mother of four children, made a special request from Pakdemirli. She said that she wanted to welcome President Erdoğan in her house and asked Pakdemirli to help him with it.
Emphasizing that she loved President Erdoğan very much, "I will be even the mukhtar if necessary. How I wish the President would accept my invitation," Nazmiye Bağdatlı said.
Showing the cameras, Minister Pakdemirli said that she could make a call from there.
Thereon, she addressed the President:
"I would like to invite the President and his wife to my house. I had a dream once. We were sitting around a floor table. And the President was sitting confident and proud as usual. I love him very much, you know. May God protect you from all evil!  May God bless you! You have always worked hard for our country. I will be a mukhtar candidate simply because you come together with the mukhtars from time to time. I will take the votes of 1001 citizens living in Göksu District. We wish to see you, your Excellency, my President,  with these 1001 votes at this table."

Title: “TURKISH FORESTRY SECTOR MEETING”
Paragraphs:
Bekir Pakdemirli, Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, delivered a speech in the Turkish Forestry Sector Meeting organized in order to develop forest sector by the General Directorate of Forestry under the auspices of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
FORESTRY SECTOR MET IN ANKARA
Pointing out that the forests are the lungs, the ornaments, and the power of a country, Minister Pakdemirli said that the meeting where all the stakeholders of the forest sector came together, was important for increasing the economic and social capacity of the forestry sector, gaining dynamism with a commercial acceleration, receiving the demands of the sector, identifying the problems and producing solutions together.
Indicating that approximately 4.5 billion of saplings have been planted in a total area of more than 5 million hectares since 2003, Minister Pakdemirli emphasized that,  according to the results of studies done, Turkey was one of the countries which increased their forested and green areas.
127 MILLION OF CREDIT AND GRANT SUPPORT
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Bekir Pakdemirli also touched on the support given for the credits and grants so far in his speech. "We have provided 127 million Turkish liras of credit and grant support by encouraging the requests of our green-loving people to set up special afforestation and private forest nurseries. One million of the lands of the homeland was prevented from being transported by erosion as well.
"WE HAVE ACHIEVED TO BE THE FIRST IN THE WORLD"
Thousands of hectares of pasture areas are rehabilitated every year to protect the land and support the villagers and livestock. "We have increased our capacity of seed and seedling production to a total of over 500 million and achieved to produce endangered juniper seedlings without using chemical methods for the first time in the world," Minister Pakdemirli said.
CAMPAIGN IN AN AREA OF 6 MILLION HECTARES
Minister Pakdemirli stated that it was aimed that their country would be among the leading countries in seedling exports by supporting private sector nursery. In this respect, Pakdemirli said that they were paving the way for forest tree seedling cultivation in forest areas and that the Young Stand Care Campaign was implemented in an area of 6 million hectares to ensure forest continuity.
4 BILLION INCOME FROM 10 MILLION DEGRADED LAND
There are about 10 million hectares of degraded forest lands in Turkey. At the meeting where the forest sector came together, Minister Pakdemirli stated that these areas would be rehabilitated primarily by afforesting with income-generating fruit tree species and inoculating wild fruit species. "In this way, both the national economy will be provided with an additional income of approximately 4 billion liras annually, and the negative effects of global warming, climate change and desertification on our country will be minimized," he said.
"WE CONCENTRATE ON INDUSTRIAL AFFORESTATION"
" Within this scope, we will minimize the negative effects of global warming, climate change and desertification. We increased the production of forestry products which was 21 million cubic meters in 2017 by increasing 50% in the years of 2018 and 2019 to 31 million cubic meters as of this year," said Minister Pakdemirli and he continued:
"As a result of these efforts, we exported as much as we imported valuing 800 million dollars in 2018. Our ultimate goal is to meet all of the raw material needs of our country from domestic sources, especially the paper sector, thereby eliminating the current deficit of about $ 4 billion annually. "
"In order to realize this goal, we have concentrated on industrial afforestation purposing wood production. In this sense, we have planned to make industrial afforestation in 300 thousand hectares, in 1 million hectares in the medium term by 2023. When the industrial afforestation starts to produce, about 18 million cubic meters of products will be gained."
GOOD NEWS FOR THE FOREST VILLAGERS!
Minister Pakdemirli gave good news to the forest villagers. Reminding that approximately 6.8 million forest villagers have been supported by grants and zero-interest supports, the Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, Bekir Pakdemirli, has also announced the decision to give support for the renovation of the domestic electrical installation of the village houses as well as the purchasing of the logging cranes, tractors and saw machines demanded by the forest villagers working in production as of 2019 in addition to the existing supports.
Stating that they had been working decisively for increasing the forest assets of Turkey, Minister Pakdemirli said: "About 4.5 billion of saplings have been planted in a total area of more than 5 million hectares during the last 17 years. In this context, in line with the 2023 targets, the aim will be to plant 7 billion saplings in an area of 6 million 191 thousand hectares and increase the forest assets of Turkey to 23.5 million hectares, which means 30% of the surface area of our country.

Title: MOBILIZATION AGAINST EURYGASTER IN ANKARA
Paragraphs:
Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry conducted pest control against the increasing eurygaster population in Ankara.
After Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Dr. Bekir Pakdemirli sent a circular regarding fight against eurygaster to 81 provincial directorates; the work has been intensified. In areas where eurygaster populations increased, which results in loss of quality and yield of cereals, pesticide use has been focused on.
Within this framework, pest control was carried out at the points detected in Gölbaşı, Ankara.
WORK HAS BEEN CARRIED OUT IN A CEREAL AREA OF 5 MILLION DECARES
Having stated that if pest management activities are not conducted; the half of the wheat area could come under the threat of the eurygaster, Agriculture and Forestry Minister Dr. Bekir Pakdemirli has noted: ''This pest leads to 10-50 % yield and quality loss. The protein of wheat having certain eurygaster absorption rate decreases; and loses its property of being bread, pasta, bulgur and results in loss of billions of dollars."
Having mentioned that 34 technical teams composed of 133 staff are charged in order to manage this pest, Minister Pakdemirli has noted that work has been ongoing in 498 neighborhoods of 20 districts in Ankara, approximately 5 million decares of cereal areas.
USE OF CHEMICALS IN AN AREA OF 2 MILLION DECARES
Minister Pakdemirli stated ''within the scope of the pest management, biological struggle is carried out at the first place with the release of beneficial insects to the cereal areas. In areas where eurygaster damage is high, use of chemicals is given priority. We are using chemicals for a month, in an area of 2 million decares.''
Bülent Korkmaz, Ankara Provincial Director of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, mentioned in his statement that the provincial and district directorates of the Ministry have been on red alert against the eurygaster.
DAMAGE AIMED LESS THAN 1 PERCENT
Having noted that damage could reach up to 20 percent when eurygaster is not controlled Mr. Korkmaz stated; ''Severe losses occur in both quality and yield. Therefore, our farmers cannot sell their products even the price for fodders. The fight against this pest is extremely important.''
Having stressed that reducing the damage caused by the eurygaster to less than 1 percent is aimed, Mr. Korkmaz added:
"This year the farmers will be smiling thanks to the fight against eurygaster, trainings in the field, the soil analysis and timely fertilization and the fact that the rainfall is above the annual average. 1 million tons of wheat was harvested in Ankara last year. We expect the figure to increase by 30 percent and reach up to 1 million 300 thousand tons this year.''

Title: FOOD ENTERPRISES WAS FINED 36.5 MILLION TL AS A RESULT OF INSPECTIONS
Paragraphs:
452.477 food inspections were made by Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry this year which also includes Ramadan month period, and as a result of the food inspections; 36.5 million TL was fined.
Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry continues to food inspections at regular intervals in order for our citizens to access to healthy and quality food.
In this context; the number of food inspectors was gone up from 1.500 in 2002 to 6.825 at the end of last year, and the number of food inspectors is 7.129 as from June 2019.
The number of food inspections was gone up from 39.646 in 2002 to 1.124.918 at the end of last year. Within the period of Jan 1 to June 10, 2019 which also includes Ramadan month, the number of food inspections was recorded as 452.477.
The number of penalties imposed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry was gone up to 18.164 at the end of last year. Furthermore, the number of penalties is 5.039 till June 10, 2019.
As a result of food inspections, 62 denunciations were made by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry. The number of denunciations was 551 in 2002 and 186 at the end of last year.
The amount of penalty has been 36.541.955 TL within this year. This amount was 107.306.405 TL in the last year.
THE MOST DENUNCIATIONS WERE MADE FOR FOOD PRODUCTION AREAS
When the range of food inspections on the base of food enterprises was examined, collective consumption places were the first rank by the number of 190.900 inspections. The inspection numbers of food selling spaces and food production areas are 187.107 and 74.470 respectively.
The most penalties were imposed on food selling places. The number of penalties imposed on the food production areas was 1.840 and the number of penalties imposed on the collective consumption places was 1.297. The number of denunciations for food production areas, food selling areas and collective consumption places was 39, 15 and 8 respectively.
1.645 FOOD PRODUCTS WERE DISCLOSED
2.201.820 calls for 174 Alo GIDA HATTI (Food Line) which started to be used in 2009 were made until 10 June.  Complaint applications belonging to 608.254 calls in the total number of 2.201.820 calls were resulted in. 48.936 criminal actions were taken accordingly.
As a result of the inspections made by the Ministry, the companies which adulterated and produced fake food were announced to the public, and in this context, during the period of 2002-2019 public disclosure was made 20 times. In these statements, a total of 1.609 party products of 769 companies were disclosed.

Title: RECORD NUMBER OF VISITORS IN NATURE PARKS
Paragraphs:
4 million 61 thousand people visited national and nature parks during the Eid El-Fitr.
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, Mr. Bekir Pakdemirli made a statement and expressed that he is very pleased to see that citizens prefer sites where they can feel the nature during the Ramadan. He also stated "National parks broke a record in terms of visitor number and almost 4 million 61 thousand people visited the protected areas of Turkey."
In Turkey, surrounded by water on its three sides, there are 44 national parks, 247 nature parks, 30 nature protected areas and 114 nature monuments under the responsibility of the Directorate General for Nature Conservation and National Parks (DKMP) of the Ministry.
During the Ramadan holiday, the greatest number of people (approximately 551 thousand) visited Uzuntarla Nature Park in Kocaeli Province of Turkey. The other most preferred nature parks are located in Gaziantep.
Minister Pakdemirli also expressed that national parks will always serve for the citizens in all seasons. People living in urban areas can visit the nature parks when they are willing to go out of their routine in the cities and take a breath of fresh air in an area where they can see every shade of green.

Title: “17 JUNE WORLD DAY TO COMBAT DESERTIFICATION AND DROUGHT”
Paragraphs:
Capital Ankara will host the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought Day activities on 17 June.
The fact that this important organization which is held every year in a different country and which will be held in Ankara this year coincides with the 25th anniversary of the adoption of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification increases the importance of the event.
It is aimed to raise public awareness about the negative effects and its consequences of desertification and drought at these events.
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Dr. Bekir Pakdemirli will deliver a speech at the opening on 17 June within the scope of the event.
Within the scope of World Day to Combat Desertification, many events such as photo contest, panel and International Soil Congress will be held on 17-19 June in Ankara.
The ceremonies will be attended by ministers and senior bureaucrats from around 20 countries and 16 media members from international agencies, around 50 experts from 20 countries, and 58 international researchers will also participate in the International Soil Congress.
The main framework of the activities will be the combat against desertification and land destruction and the effects seen in different parts of the society; but at the same time different issues will also be raised.

Title: SUPPORT FROM THE MINISTER PAKDEMİRLİ TO THE FAMILY WHICH THEIR ANIMALS PERISHED AS A RESULT OF THE LIGHTNING FALL
Paragraphs:
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Bekir Pakdemirli supported to the family which their animals perished as a result of lightning fall in the village of Şerbetli in Çanakkale Biga district by providing three cattle with calves.
Pakdemirli gave instructions to the Director of Çanakkale Agriculture and Forestry Erdem Karadağ and his team for relieving Kızık Family who lost their 10 cattle (8 pregnant) as a result of lightning fall in the village of Şerbetli.
Thereupon, Erdem Karadağ provide 3 cattle with calves to Gökhan and Lütfiye Kızık. The family, who was sad for losing their animals, became very happy with this support.
PAKDEMİRLİ CALLED THE FAMILY
Pakdemirli made video call with the family and he said that he learned the event with a great sadness.
Pakdemirli noted that the incident was a natural event and said, "Immediately I gave instructions to my friends. At least for a consolation, we sent these animals to you. The state is with you. Hopefully we are in an effort to do the best to please you at the point. We are always by your side. Agriculture and livestock and being with you as a state is very important. The state is always with you. I also convey the greetings of our President. Hopefully when I come to Çanakkale, I would like to visit you in your village. If you come to Ankara, I'm always waiting for you here."
"I DID NOT WANT TO BELIEVE WHEN I WENT TO THE SCENE OF ACCIDENT"
The producer Gökhan Kızık thanked Pakdemirli for his sensitivity.
Kızık expressed that they are very happy for not leaving alone. He said, "Our 10 out of 8 pregnant cattle perished. I don't want to believe when I went to the scene of accident. It was very painful. Our only livelihood is livestock. God bless our state. They didn't leave us unsupported in this helpless day. I would like to thank the President, the Minister, the Provincial Director and all those involved."
Lütfiye Kızık invited Pakdemirli to their village and thanked them for their intimacy.

Title: MMB: DISEASED MEAT ALLEGATION IS GROUNDLESS
Paragraphs:
Meat and Milk Board (MMB) made a statement regarding the allegations that diseased meat was sent to Mehmetçik (Turkish soldiers):
A necessity of an explanation has been emerged on the news "Diseased Meat has been sent to Turkish Soldiers" dated 17.06.2019.
"In accordance with the protocol we have made with the Turkish Armed Forces, any unhealthy meat or any processed products obtained from them cannot be used in our delivered meat and meat products and it have not been used until today.
We show great respect to Mehmetçik, the allegations are groundless.
Legal action shall be taken against the person and persons who make such claims.
We would like to inform the public that Meat and Milk Board will continue to be sensitive about 'healthy and safe food production'".

Title: VEGETABLE PRODUCTION INCREASED BY 5 MILLION TONS SINCE 2002
Paragraphs:
Vegetable consumption in our country along with the world is increasing every year. The amount of products purchased in production areas since 2002 has increased by approximately 5 million tons…
Vegetable production has an important place in our country's agricultural activities.
The amount of production in Turkey in 2018 showed an increase of approximately 5.4 percent in cereals and other crops, 2.7 percent in vegetables, 5.8 percent in fruits, beverages and spice crops compared to the last year.
Total vegetable production increased with policies and efficiency implemented. According to TURKSTAT data, total vegetable production, which was 25.823.567 tons in 2002, reached 30.032.827 tons in 2018.
In the amount of vegetable production that increases every year, the expectation for 2019 is 30.834.882 tons compared to the previous year.
Production amounts are estimated to be approximately 67.9 million tons for cereals and other crops and 23.6 million tons for fruits, beverages and spices in 2019.

Title: FLOOD DISASTER IN TRABZON
Paragraphs:
Floods occurred in Çamlıktepe and Yüceyurt Neighborhood as a result of local strong rains started in the evening of June 13 in the Çamlıktepe and Yüceyurt Neighborhood basin of Araklı district of Trabzon.
According to preliminary determinations due to floods, a school, 3 houses and 2 workplaces were partially (approximately 20 cm) flooded and there were no casualties. Construction machineries were sent to the region immediately.
However, as the work continued, Tuesday (June 18), heavy rain began again in the region. With the DSI facilities, landslides occurred along with the rock fragment that broke from the mountain in the part where the machine was working and after the flood, the DSİ work machine and operator were caught in the water. In addition, no information was received from the 3 staff of Trabzon Metropolitan Municipality working in this field. According to the first determinations in the region, four houses were demolished due to landslides.
A total of 7 citizens lost their lives in the disaster, while 4 injured citizens were taken under treatment in the nearest hospital. The search for 3 missing persons continues. In the Yeşilyurt and Çamlıktepe neighborhoods, the most affected places by the disaster, 76 citizens have been evacuated so far.
Minister of Agriculture and Forestry Bekir Pakdemirli went to Trabzon to investigate the incident. While AFAD and DSI teams continued their exploration efforts, a crisis table was set up at Araklı District Governorate under the coordination of Trabzon Governor İsmail Ustaoğlu.
In addition to this, our General Directorate of Meteorology remarked that there is still a risk of flash flood, deluge, stroke of lightning and landslide until the end of the week in the region because of the continuation of the rainfall in the Eastern Black Sea region for the next five days and strong local rainfall especially in Giresun, Trabzon, Rize ve Artvin inland areas on Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
